name: Local Government Districts 1991 (provisional recommendations)
description: The 25 districts the Local Government Boundaries Commissioner provisionally recommended on 3 September 1991. Moyle and Ballymoney were to merge as a new district, Dalriada, and the Glens (Glendun, Glenaan and Glenariff wards, with the Loughguile hills of Ballyhoe and Corkey ward) were to pass to Ballymena. The merger was dropped in the revised recommendations of February 1992. Rathfriland and Tullycarn already pass to Banbridge, as in the final scheme.

references.label: Review of Local Government Boundaries: Provisional Recommendations for Northern Ireland, Local Government Boundaries Commissioner (September 1991)
references.note: Published 3 Sep 1991. Section 9 and the Dalriada and Ballymena sections set out the Dalriada merger and the transfer of the Glens to Ballymena; the ward schedules list the townlands of the proposed Glendun and Glenariff wards. Printed report; no online copy found.

references.label: Review of Local Government Boundaries: Revised Recommendations, Local Government Boundaries Commissioner (February 1992)
references.note: Published 20 Feb 1992; section 4 withdraws the Dalriada proposal and keeps the existing boundaries of Ballymoney, Moyle and Ballymena.

references.label: Review of Local Government Boundaries: Report by the Local Government Boundaries Commissioner, Dr M N Hayes (HMSO, June 1992)
references.note: Final stage; given effect by S.R. 1992 No. 303.

references.label: OSNI Open Data - Largescale Boundaries - Local Government Districts (1993)
references.note: District geometry used for the 21 districts unchanged in the final scheme and as the base for the others.

references.label: Local Government Boundaries Commissioner (Northern Ireland) Order 1990 (S.I. 1990 No. 2149)
references.note: Made 31 Oct 1990, in force 1 Nov 1990. Amended section 50(1) of the Local Government Act (Northern Ireland) 1972 so that a Local Government Boundaries Commissioner was appointed in 1990 rather than 1992, and thereafter 10 to 15 years after each final report: the review whose provisional (3 Sep 1991) and final (June 1992) recommendations gave the 1993 districts and wards.

note: Gains the Glens (Glendun, Glenaan, Glenariff wards of Moyle as constituted 1985) and part of Ballyhoe and Corkey ward (Ballymoney), as two new wards Glendun and Glenariff (26 wards). Dropped at the revised stage.

Proposed merger of Moyle and Ballymoney (20 wards) less the Glendun, Glenaan and Glenariff wards of Moyle and the Loughguile upland part of Ballyhoe and Corkey ward (Ballymoney), which went to Ballymena. Dropped at the revised stage (Feb 1992).

Rathfriland (from Newry and Mourne) and Tullycarn townland (from Craigavon) already transferred, as in the final scheme; the Dromara part of Crossgar townland stays in Banbridge (it went to Lisburn only at the revised stage).
Without the Dromara part of Crossgar townland (added at the revised stage).
